3. This dipteran fly from Central and South America employs an ingenious and complex reproductive strategy involving a "biological delivery service." The female does not approach its target directly; instead, it captures a mosquito or another blood-sucking insect and glues its eggs to the captive's body. When that secondary insect eventually lands on a host, the localized warmth triggers the eggs to hatch instantly. Identify this fly.
